scope: Correct final identity emission for the optional NAVISWORKSMODEL definition reference in the public low-level DXF serializer.

issue.before: writeNavisworksModel emitted the source definitionHandle as a literal group-340 value even when a source-handle remap or caller reference resolver was configured.
issue.impact: Low-level write callers could produce a reference to a source identity that does not exist in the output drawing.

behavior: A nonzero definition handle is translated through the configured reference resolver when present; the resolver result is final.
Without a resolver, the definition handle uses the established source-handle remap fallback.
A resolver result of zero continues to omit this optional reference.
The concrete dwg2dxf adapter remains fail-closed for nonzero definition references until P4 graph closure qualifies them.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory NAVISWORKSMODEL record; no DWG/DXF fixture files.
cases: reference-resolver final identity overrides the configured remap

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; both ASCII/Binary x resolver/remap cases, 0.41 seconds

limitations: Generated low-level DXF reference translation only; it does not prove definition-target existence, object kind, graph closure, external asset availability, physical producer coverage, or native consumer behavior.
The adapter graph gate remains fail-closed for nonzero NAVISWORKSMODEL definition references.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
